_note: Known twin drift, ratcheted: a gap added here must be closed to remove it, and a closed gap left in this file fails the check. Keep "reason" honest — it is the audit trail for why a platform diverges.

anggaran/budget.reason: Prefix shared since the M3 convergence, but Android folds the total-card and per-category card content INTO TC-BUDGET-08/09's row-text assertions instead of asserting them as their own cases, and its Ubah/Hapus flow is one case where iOS has 05. Ids match; coverage granularity does not (residual of code_review.md M3/M11). Close: split Android 08/09 into -03/-04/-05 — budget.spec.ts is device-green at 8 passing, so the split re-verifies in ~1m.

transaksi/transaction-list.reason: Partly a stated scanner blind spot: Android's bulk-seed chunks are built in a loop and their titles come from a variable (transaction-list.spec.ts:220), so no id is visible at that single call site, while iOS's matching it.skip placeholder names TC-LIST-08a literally — which reads as iOS-only. The divergence underneath is real: iOS never ported bulk seeding and BOTH TC-LIST-08 cases are it.skip there. Close: port the seed and scroll cases to iOS, then this pair lines up literally.

anggaran.reason: One-directional: iOS is the richer API (code_review.md parity row 'anggaran 100 % — iOS adds 14 helpers'). Two drivers, both platform mechanics rather than neglect: iOS has no UiScrollable and no implicit system back, so sheet and form state is probed explicitly (isFormDisplayed, isFormSaveEnabled, isDeleteSheetDisplayed, cancelDeleteSheet, tapRowDelete); and the progress bar's FILL fraction is not exposed to accessibility on iOS — only the track node — so proportion is measured via rowBarWidth/totalCardBarWidth plus the rendered 'Rp X dari Rp Y' text (anggaran.ios.page.ts:199-211). Close: port a helper to Android only when an Android spec needs it; do not add dead API.

cadangan.reason: Not portable. The iOS helper reads UIKit's LP.CaptionBar.TopCaption from the share popover (cadangan.ios.page.ts:59) and is asserted by backup.ios.spec.ts:109. On Android the same export opens the SYSTEM share sheet (com.android.intentresolver) whose contents sit outside the app's tree, so the Android twin verifies the export by reading cache/backups/saku-cadangan.* through adb run-as while the sheet is up (cadangan.page.ts header, BUG_Found_02). Close: assert the written file on both sides and drop the iOS caption read — do not fake an Android getter.

daftar.reason: Both directions are locator mechanics. The Android-only names are element handles used by Android waits: monthLabelEl feeds monthLabel(), emptyState backs emptyStateTexts() and backup.spec.ts:268 — and the iOS specs reach that same tag by calling iosByTag directly (backup.ios.spec.ts:158, edit-transaction.ios.spec.ts:121), so the getter is genuinely absent from the iOS page object. The iOS-only names exist because rows must be located by GEOMETRY: a tagged Compose container hoists its strings to siblings (BUG_Found_13) and there is no UiScrollable scrollIntoView to match text — hence findTransactionRow/countTransactionRows/firstCardPosition. Close: add the two getters to DaftarIosPage and switch those three call sites; keep the iOS geometry reads as designed.

kategori.reason: The sharpest remaining drift, and the one code_review.md M13 flags. iOS exposes step-level API (openAddForm/createCategory/rowEdit/rowHide/typeRename/saveRename/cancelRename/waitForDialogClosed/dismissSheet/isHidden/setHidden/renameFieldText/findCustomCategoryId/addButton/addFormScreen) while Android folds the same flows into two composites (renameInDialog, toggleHidden): different abstraction granularity, not missing locators. The cost is concrete — Android's composites back TC-KAT-08/10, which are it.skip there (category-management.spec.ts:122, BUG_Found_04 rename-dialog self-dismiss) yet RUN on iOS through the step API (category-management.ios.spec.ts:29-30), so the platforms do not verify the same contract. Close: converge Android onto the iOS granularity, the M1/M2 pattern; do not collapse iOS into composites.

reason: Baseline recorded 2026-10-28 by scripts/check_parity.mjs. 'Accepted' means explained and carrying a named close action above — not a list to mass-delete. The two missingTwins entries: src/tests/ringkasan/summary.spec.ts is the 13-case TC-SUM suite that was never ported (IOS_PHASE1_HANDOFF.md §1.E) — its page object, ringkasan.ios.page.ts, only reached full surface parity on 2026-10-28 (M2) and has still not been exercised on a simulator, so the port must start with an MCP verification pass; src/tests/transaksi/delete-undo.spec.ts is built on Android-only helpers (tapUndoAction, allByTagMatches/byTag) and the 6-second undo-toast window (finding M14), so its iOS twin needs an iOS undo path before it can be written. Note for anyone debugging the gate: tambah.page.ts:64-110 (selectCategory) is indented 3 spaces instead of 2, a formatting defect under finding S2, and an indent-trusting parser reads that as a missing Android method — which is why check_parity.mjs does not trust indentation. Re-run with `npm run check:parity -- --update` only after a deliberate tree change: reasons carry over per group, and a group whose drift has vanished still FAILS until its entry is removed.
